positive.prompt: Break this spec into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria
Turn the PRD into an ordered task list we can execute
Plan the work into implementable chunks before we start coding

negative.prompt: Encode the output so it is safe against XSS

evals.prompt: Break the attached notifications spec into an executable plan.
evals.expected_output: Ordered tasks in tasks/plan.md, each small, verifiable, with acceptance criteria and dependencies
expectations: Tasks are vertical slices rather than horizontal layers
No implementation code is written during planning

evals.prompt: Read the attached review-guidance comparison brief and write the implementation plan and task list. Plan the delegated work and its acceptance checks; do not run the comparison or implement the guidance change.
evals.expected_output: A plan and task list with bounded delegation, the existing exhausted review budget, revision-scoped evidence reuse, a matched comparison and separate final cases
expectations: The plan gives each proposed worker a goal, input revision, file scope, permitted actions, expected artifact and acceptance check, without granting publication or merge rights
The existing two-round task budget remains exhausted across the loaded skills; the plan preserves the disputed candidate rather than scheduling two more identical rounds
The passing v2 retry check is reused only for the same revision and retry property, with authorization coverage still unverified
The comparison uses the same cases, model, effort, tools and permissions in both arms and independently verifies actual outcomes instead of accepting tool-use claims
Final evaluation cases are reserved separately from cases used while tuning the guidance
The plan and task list preserve the human approval checkpoint, and no implementation or comparison run occurs during planning
